paper_id: Huang et al. - 2011 - Optimal sampling algorithms for frequency estimation in distributed data
title: Optimal Sampling Algorithms for Frequency Estimation in Distributed Data
motivation: 分布式系统中估算全局频率开销大,现有均匀采样在节点数n较小时不够高效
problem_framing: 在εN绝对误差约束下,最小化节点与协调器间的通信量,形式化为采样函数设计问题
key_insight: 线性采样函数g₁(x)=x√n/εN达到O(√n/ε)通信复杂度,二次采样函数g₂达到instance-optimal
method_signature: g₁与g₂采样函数+Bloom过滤器编码压缩传输位数
evaluation_criteria: 方差Var[Yi]≤O((εN)²),最坏情况与实例最优性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: g₁仅worst-case最优而非instance-optimal;instance-optimality仅在定义的sampling framework内成立
evidence_for_taste: g₂ generally 2 to 3 times cheaper than g₁
we would claim that our algorithms are both theoretically interesting and practically useful
instance-optimality will not be possible to achieve if we do not have any restrictions
it remains an interesting problem to see if there is an instance-optimal sampling function for (p, ε)-errors
thinking_moves: 从Zhao等人的general framework出发,改进采样函数形式
先证worst-case下界,再设计匹配的最优采样函数
利用线性特性使Bloom filter编码成为可能
通过实例最优性证明超越最坏情况的表达能力
